entities.summary: Yaroslav Viktorovich Antonov is a Russian former volleyball player who won a silver medal while playing for the Soviet Union in the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul. He was a powerful left-handed spiker who led the Soviet team in the late 1980s.
